# Old-Games.RU — Virgil’s catalogue review

- Original source: [Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood](https://www.old-games.ru/game/10276.html)
- Author / publication: Virgil; Old-Games.RU; comments by other registered users.
- Language / date: Russian; review date not displayed, inspected comments dated 2020-09-15 and 2020-09-16.
- Access: Catalogue review, rating image description, and three displayed comments inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Virgil’s catalogue review rates the game 6/10 and treats it as an appealing but less deep relative of Commandos 2. It covers camp assignments, optional money raids, beggar information, and character specialization. This is a distinct text and author from the [redwings article](old-games-redwings.md).

The comments add separate player accounts: Опричник Егор discusses recruitment, castle-defense alternatives, and repeatedly reassigning crowded camp workers; RaymanM describes a distraction-and-knockout tactic; Грендель finds mouse gestures entertaining initially but tiring later. These comments are useful leads for testing mechanics, not confirmed rules. The reviewer’s release chronology should not be used as an authoritative timeline.
